The album showcases their signature style of combining lush instrumentation with introspective moods, reflecting their evolution since their debut.

"20" serves as a contemporary statement from The Soulsavers, following their earlier works that often incorporated collaborations with vocalists and a mix of genres including alternative and electronic music. The album was released as a limited edition vinyl and received attention for its immersive production and cohesive sonic narrative. While specific details on commercial reception are limited, the album has been noted for its artistic depth and appeal to both longtime fans and new listeners within the alternative electronic rock scene.
